verses.gurmukhi: ੧੪ : ਬੇਮੁਖ ਦਾ ਸਭ ਕੁਛ ਪੁੱਠਾ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 14 : bemukh dhaa sabh kuchh pu'Thaa hai

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਹੁਰਾ ਮਿਠਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਰੁਠੀ ਨੋ ਤੁਠੀ।
verses.translit_en: mahuraa miThaa aakheeaai ruThee no tuThee|

en.bdb: The foolish would say the poison sweet and the angry person a happy one.
To the extinguished lamp he says the enlarged one and a killed goat to him is dressed one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿਆ ਠੰਢਾ ਗਈ ਨੋ ਆਈ ਤੇ ਉਠੀ।
verses.translit_en: jaliaa Tha(n)ddaa giee no aaiee te uThee|

en.bdb: To burnt he would say the cooled one: the 'gone' for him is 'come' and the 'come' one for him is eloped one i.e. if something sets in the eye, the eye is said to be soaring and if a widow settles in someone's house by marrying him, she is said to have elo

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਹਮਕੁ ਭੋਲਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਭ ਗਲਿ ਅਪੁਠੀ।
verses.translit_en: ahamak bholaa aakheeaai sabh gal apuThee|

en.bdb: To moron he would say simple, and his all talks will be contrary to normal.

verses.gurmukhi: ਉਜੜੁ ਤ੍ਰਟੀ ਬੇਮੁਖਾਂ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਖਨਿ ਵੁਠੀ।
verses.translit_en: aujaR traTee bemukhaa(n) tis aakhan vuThee|

en.bdb: To the ruining person, the foolish would say that he is leaving everything of his own sweet will.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੋਰੈ ਸੰਦੀ ਮਾਉ ਜਿਉਂ ਲੁਕਿ ਰੋਵੈ ਗੁਠੀ ॥੧੪॥
verses.translit_en: chorai sa(n)dhee maau jiau(n) luk rovai guThee ||14||

en.bdb: Such people are like the mother of a thief who weeps hiding in a corner (lest she is detected and possibility of catching hold of her son increases).
